sentences.native: How is the weather today in Munich?
sentences.speaker: A
sentences.target: Wie ist das Wetter heute in München?

sentences.native: It is cold and it is raining.
sentences.speaker: B
sentences.target: Es ist kalt und es regnet.

sentences.native: Is the sun not shining at all?
